title: Sean Payton: We're preparing for Patrick Mahomes at his best

sources.title: Sean Payton: We're preparing for Patrick Mahomes at his best
sources.description: Throughout the offseason program and training camp, all indications have been that Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes would be ready to play Week 1 against the Broncos — despite suffering a torn ACL in December.
